transcript: Speaker A: Mera divorce ho gaya tha. Na sasural mein jagah mil rahi thi aur na hi maike mein kyunki meri love marriage tooti thi. Mera naam Anjali hai. [I got divorced. But respect vanished, and after 8 years he remarried and asked for a divorce. I came to my parents' house, but my brother and sister-in-law didn't welcome me. My English was zero, making job interviews impossible. I felt hopeless. One night, I saw an ad for the English Seekho app featuring an AI coach that doesn't judge. I downloaded it for a 1-rupee trial. I practiced basic sentences and interview preparation with the AI coach daily. Within a month, my confidence grew. I got a job starting at 18,000 rupees, got promoted to 25,000 rupees, moved into my own place, and became independent. Now, even my sister-in-law asks for the app's name. If you also stay silent in interviews or offices, download English Seekho. Practice with the AI coach. A 1-rupee trial is cheaper than a social media reel.
